ev.q: received five reports of Guillain-Barré syndrome (GBS) in persons after receipt of MCV4 vaccination
No cases of GBS have been detected among nearly 110,000 MCV4 recipients
These cases were reported from Pennsylvania (two), New York, Ohio, and New Jersey (one case each).
Data from two VSD sites indicated that 86%--97% of vaccine recipients had 6 weeks of follow-up
All five persons had been vaccinated during June 10--July 25.
is similar to what might have been expected to occur by chance alone.
